inputs.text: South Dakota is right to treat citizenship as a basic part of voting in its own state elections. Senate Bill 175 is a limited safeguard: it applies only to new registrants and state elections. Protecting confidence in the ballot is part of responsible self-government, not an unreasonable demand. A state’s future should be decided by its citizens.

output.main_topic: Support for South Dakota requiring citizenship for voting in state elections
subtopics: Senate Bill 175 applies only to new registrants and state elections
